P.name: Clockwork Windup
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - The Ball:}} '''Orianna''' is accompanied by ''The Ball'', which she commands with her {{tip|abilities}}. ''The Ball'' incurs a {{sti|cd|{{fd|0.01}}-second}} global cooldown on all of her abilities when she casts any ability. Additionally, ''The Ball'' attaches to '''Orianna''' if she is near it, and snaps back to her if she moves too far away from it, which incurs a {{sti|cd|{{fd|0.75}}-second}} cooldown on ''{{ai|Command: Shockwave|Orianna}}''.
P.description2:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Orianna's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Clockwork Winding'' for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 2 times. All stacks are lost when attacking a new enemy.

{{sbc|Clockwork Winding:}} '''Orianna's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to deal {{pp|10 + (50-10)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}, increased by{{ft|15%|{{pp|10*0.15 + (50*0.15-10*0.15)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|15*0.15}}% AP)}}}}per stack, up to {{pp|10*(1+0.15*2) + (50*(1+0.15*2)-10*(1+0.15*2))/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|15*(1+0.15*2)}}% AP)}} {{as|'''total bonus''' magic damage}}.
P.description3: ''See [[Orianna#Pets|Pets]] for more details about The Ball.''

Q.name: Command: Attack
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Orianna''' commands ''{{ai|Clockwork Windup|Orianna|The Ball}}'' to fly to the target location and remain there, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies it passes through and nearby enemies upon arrival, reduced to 70% against those hit beyond the first.

W.name: Command: Dissonance
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Orianna''' commands ''{{ai|Clockwork Windup|Orianna|The Ball}}'' to emit an electric pulse that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
W.description2: The pulse leaves behind an electric field that last 3 seconds, granting {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} to '''Orianna''' and her allies when they move within. Enemies that move within the field are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by the same amount, decaying over 2 seconds after leaving.

E.name: Command: Protect
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} ''{{ai|Clockwork Windup|Orianna|The Ball}}'' grants {{sti|armor|{{as| '''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} to the unit it is attached to.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Orianna''' commands ''The Ball'' to fly to herself or the target allied {{tip|champion}} and attach itself to the target, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies it passes through and granting the target a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds upon arrival.
E.leveling2:

{{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|55 to 195}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}}}}

R.name: Command: Shockwave
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Orianna''' commands ''{{ai|Clockwork Windup|Orianna|The Ball}}'' to unleash a shockwave that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, and {{tip|airborne|pulls}} them over 325 units, though not through terrain.
